_comment: PICK YOUR POISON: most events offer the SAME three trades in the same order — spend TIME (slow, safe), CREW (power through), or BIKES (send it). No option is ever 'best'; the magnitude/color preview + your bars tell you which to pick. Text is punched up with kid slang for flavor, but the leading VERB still signals the trade (wait/stop = time, power/muscle/sprint = crew, send/gun/bomb = bikes). Effects are balanced — keep them if you rewrite the words.

events.title: Flat Tire!
events.description: PSSSSFT. A tire just went flat. Classic.

choices.text: Stop and patch it up right
Everybody lock in for a speed-fix
Eh, just send it on the flat

events.title: Chain's Cooked
events.description: A chain snapped mid-pedal. It is straight up cooked.

choices.text: Take your time, fix it clean
Grind on with the busted chain

events.title: Bent Wheel!
events.description: Somebody ate a curb and now the wheel is all wobbly.

events.title: Deer!!
events.description: A deer YEETS across the road right in front of you.

events.title: Dog Chase!
events.description: A big ol' dog is fully chasing the crew. It is locked in.

events.title: Rainstorm
events.description: Sky opens up. You are getting absolutely SOAKED.

choices.text: Wait it out under a tree

events.title: Heat Wave
events.description: It is HOT hot. Everyone's melting, no cap.

choices.text: Chill in the shade a sec
Grit it out, hold the pace
Race to the next shady spot

events.title: Brutal Headwind
events.description: A wall of wind is shoving you backward. Rude.

choices.text: Ease off, wait for a break

events.title: Construction Zone
events.description: Road's completely torn up. Big L for the city.

events.title: Big Hill
events.description: A monster hill. Everyone groans out loud.

events.title: Junk Everywhere
events.description: Glass and screws all over the road. Super sketchy.

choices.text: Hop off and walk it through
Gun it and hope for the best

events.title: Cop Alert
events.description: An officer waves you down. "No sidewalk riding!"

events.title: Nosy Neighbor!
events.description: Mr. Henderson is already dialing someone. Snitch behavior.

events.title: Shortcut!
events.description: A path could cut off a HUGE chunk. Kinda risky though.

choices.text: Nah, stay on the main road

events.title: Huge Downhill!
events.description: A giant hill you can just let it ride down.

choices.text: Let it roll for good speed

events.title: Water Fountain!
events.description: A working fountain. Everyone's parched fr.

choices.text: Everybody drink up and cool off

events.title: Free Money!
events.description: A crumpled bill just sitting there. Straight W.
